body.purpose: Dense forms, descriptions, and working content.

code.purpose: Prompts, paths, IDs, evidence, and terminal content.

shadows.name: overlay-medium
shadows.purpose: Detached dialogs, menus, and popovers only.

motion.name: view-enter
motion.purpose: Softens work-area swaps with a four-pixel rise; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, selection, and compact control feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The focused action in a desktop command group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, #6e56cf); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; transition: background 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-emphasis, #7d66d9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #6958ad) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Destination
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-3, #212225); color: var(--text-1, #fcfcfd); text-align: left; font: 500 13px/20px 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; transition: background 100ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #ddeaf814); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring, #6958ad); }

components.name: Desktop Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #2e3135); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #fcfcfd); font: 400 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 100ms ease-out; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--ring, #6958ad); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #6958ad) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Scope Badge
components.description: Communicates workspace, global, or built-in ownership.
components.css: .ds-scope-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2f2f37); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-2, #18191b); color: var(--text-2, #b0b4ba); font: 500 12px/16px 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Workbench Panel
components.description: An attached information surface within the desktop frame.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2f2f37); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-2, #18191b); color: var(--text-1, #fcfcfd); font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; } .ds-panel p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--text-2, #b0b4ba); font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Persona State Tile
components.description: Pairs a stable chassis silhouette with one operational-state label.
components.css: .ds-persona-state { display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 112px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2f2f37); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-2, #18191b); color: var(--text-2, #b0b4ba); font: 500 12px/16px 'Geist Mono Variable', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-persona-signal { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid #3b82f6; border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #3b82f6 12%, transparent); } .ds-persona-state:hover { background: var(--surface-3, #212225); } .ds-persona-state:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #6958ad) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: LENS Workstation is a dense, precise Windows desktop harness for autonomous developer research and coding. It should feel native to a serious engineering tool: persistent navigation, information-rich split panes, compact controls, and clear agent state. The interface recedes so evidence, code, capability boundaries, and decisions stay in focus. The visual identity pairs graphite tonal layers with a disciplined violet signal. Color marks selection, focus, and action—not decoration. Typography is quiet and technical, geometry is restrained, and motion explains state changes instead of adding spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite hierarchy with violet operational signals.
Inter for interface language and Geist Mono for code or machine data.
Borders and tonal changes establish structure; effects remain restrained.
Accessibility state is explicit in labels, focus rings, validation, and status text.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet identifies the current action or focus; do not scatter it across passive decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Persona-specific neon colors may identify an avatar, but they never replace the application accent for controls.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with weight, spacing, and contrast before increasing type size.

rules.name: The Attached Surface Rule
rules.body: Tool panels belong to the workstation frame; reserve visible shadows for content that truly leaves that frame.

dos: Do use semantic tokens instead of isolated color literals.
Do keep primary commands visible while long work surfaces scroll.
Do expose identity, scope, capability, and validation state in text as well as color.
Do preserve compact keyboard-friendly Windows desktop behavior when the window resizes.
donts: Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative glow on application chrome.
Don't turn persona accent colors into competing control palettes.
Don't inflate headings or whitespace until the workstation loses useful information density.
Don't use raw external HTML for rendered research, prompts, or highlighted code.
